title: Latest update broke Mouse Without Borders: Old key not accepted, and unable to generate new key.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says the issue is fixed in the latest Dev Preview and v0.102 hotfix. Release v0.102.3101 explicitly includes the Mouse Without Borders pairing-key fix from PR #51789.
evidence: The reporter says the post-update pairing key stopped working on three Windows 10 systems.
The latest issue comment says the problem is fixed in the latest Dev Preview and the v0.102 hotfix.
Release v0.102.3101 explicitly lists the MWB pairing-key fix associated with PR #51789.

The pairing-key codec is the affected code area; the reporter confirms the hotfix release resolves the issue. judgment.recommended_action: Follow the existing issue-specific fix coverage; do not start competing work.

fix_assessment.rationale: A shipped hotfix release explicitly covers the reported pairing failure; retain that concrete fix coverage rather than propose a competing change.
